items.summary: Approve containment-only execution. Reject new production work, requeues, experiments, duplicate telemetry, dependencies, spend, monetization expansion, unsafe tactics, and unsupported revenue or causal-lift claims. Continue only existing measurement and attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence. Keep the gated product private and the prepared permission request unsent pending human-counsel review and explicit owner authorization. Owner concern: revenue covers one dated window, aggregate commission is not site-attributable, and conflicting cost records prevent ROI, margin, forecast, payback, and spend conclusions.
